role: Real clause-presence checking against real contract text — same discipline as E-04's reference verification, genuine pattern matching, never fabricated legal advice or legal interpretation.
behaviorDescription: reviewContract() checks real contract text against a real list of required clauses, verified against a full-coverage case and a missing-clause case before implementation. Reports exactly which clauses are present or missing — a factual presence check only, never legal interpretation.
hardStops: Never provides legal advice or interprets legal meaning — reports clause presence/absence only
Never claims a clause is present without a real pattern match in the actual text
